$comment: Device-spike gates (11-platform.md 4.3). webgpu.mobile flips to true only after the M01c iPhone run passes (30 min, no abnormal exit, p90 inside budget); see docs/device-spike/M01c-report.md. World switches (M02b1, DL-698): world.cards and world.massing are build-time keys read like webgpu.mobile, never from BootConfig.flags (C12 FeatureFlag is a closed union without world.* members); a remote downgrade goes through the governor knobs only. M02b2: world.rain (default true) switches the rain streaks and overlay; world.atmosphere (default false) switches the takram adapter of M10d2 on desktop-ultra at atmosphereLevel 2 (sky/atmosphere-takram.ts; QA builds also take ?atmosphere=1); on WebGL2 or when the library is missing it falls back to the M02e sky. M02e (DL-704): world.look (default true) is the full rollback switch of the look pass: false draws the M02b1/M02b2 materials on every tier with the M01c renderer state (no post stack, no shadow map). M10d0 (DL-OWN-07): world.textures (default true) switches the tiled PBR surface textures of the look: false draws the procedural ground on every tier and requests no texture/ asset. M02h3: world.cover (default true) is the rollback switch of the ground cover: false meshes the terrain from its GROUND classes alone (yards, driveways and scrub of the bake's section 21 are not drawn; setLookLayer('cover', on) is its QA toggle). M02h4: world.treeForms (default true) draws the street trees as five procedural forms in the vegetation pools (10 on desktop, 5 on mobile, 2 on mobile-low and XR): false draws M02b1's cone as one pool (a QA build also takes ?treeForms=0). M02h5: world.scatter (default true) draws the vegetation scatter of the bake (woods, park groves, shrubs and hedges: bit 7 of the TREE byte, thinned per look profile) and the far-tree impostors: false skips the scatter records and adds no impostor or understory pool (a QA build also takes ?scatter=0; setLookLayer('scatter' | 'impostors', on) are its QA toggles). M05b2: cutscene.generated (default true) is the build-time boot flag of the CutscenePlayer: false answers every cutscene request with the in-engine fallback, trigger policy.
